text: CMC Markets plc is listed on the London Stock Exchange Main Market. Per its FY2026 Annual Report's substantial-shareholdings disclosure (as at 31 March 2026), Lord Peter Andrew Cruddas holds 59.03% of voting rights and Mrs Fiona Cruddas 3.21%, with Aberforth Partners LLP (5.27%) and Schroders plc (5.06%) the next-largest holders; no state or state-fund shareholder is listed.

source.name: CMC Markets plc, Annual Report and Financial Statements 2026 (p.95, Substantial shareholdings)
source.quote: Information provided to the Company by substantial shareholders pursuant to the DTRs is published via a Regulatory Information Service and on the Company's website
